title: eCommerce Website - Monito Pets Template
description: Monito Pets is a free, complete e-commerce website template designed for pet supply stores. The template covers the full customer journey from discovery through checkout. The landing page hero features pet photography with a welcoming headline and search bar. Product categories display pet supplies organized by animal type (dogs, cats, birds, fish, small pets). Product listing pages include grid and list views with thumbnail images, name, price, rating, and add-to-cart buttons. Product detail pages have image galleries, size/color selectors, description tabs, and review sections. The shopping cart shows item quantities, pricing breakdowns, and a prominent checkout button. The checkout flow includes shipping address forms, payment method selection, and order review. Additional pages include About Us, Contact with map, Blog with pet care articles, and FAQ. The design uses a warm, friendly color palette of pet-store tones with playful iconography. The layout is fully responsive with Figma auto-layout. This template is ideal for pet stores wanting an affordable, professional e-commerce website. The template is credited to Magenest.
primary_use_case: Perfect for pet supply stores and small e-commerce businesses needing a complete, free online store template with full customer journey from browsing to checkout.
style_vibe: Warm, friendly pet store aesthetic with green tones and playful iconography — complete e-commerce flow optimized for pet supply businesses.
